events.title: Saturday Market's Holiday Market
events.blurb: Eugene Saturday Market's big indoor holiday market fills the Lane Events Center Convention Center with handcrafted gifts, art, food and live music. Admission and parking are free.
events.blurbEs: El Holiday Market del Eugene Saturday Market llena el Convention Center del Lane Events Center con regalos artesanales, arte, comida y música en vivo. La entrada y el estacionamiento son gratis.

events.title: Oregon Ducks vs. Washington Huskies
events.addr: 2700 Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Eugene, OR 97401
events.blurb: Oregon closes its regular season at home against rival Washington in a Big Ten game. Kickoff is 4:30 p.m. on NBC/Peacock.
events.blurbEs: Oregon cierra su temporada regular en casa contra su rival Washington en un partido del Big Ten. El saque inicial es a las 4:30 p.m. por NBC/Peacock.

events.title: Ballet Fantastique: Christmas Carol
events.venue: Hult Center for the Performing Arts
events.blurb: Dickens' story reimagined as a ballet set in 1940s America, with Halie Loren and her band playing a live jazz score. It runs 98 minutes with intermission and is recommended for ages 3 and up.
events.blurbEs: La historia de Dickens reimaginada como ballet en la América de los años 40, con Halie Loren y su banda tocando jazz en vivo. Dura 98 minutos con intermedio y se recomienda para mayores de 3 años.

events.title: Skinner Butte Park
events.blurb: Riverside paths and a short climb to views over the city.
events.blurbEs: Caminos junto al río y una subida corta con vistas a la ciudad.
